added: Safer chapter download completion: verify that every expected manga image was saved before a chapter is marked downloaded.
improved: Bounded retries for temporary connection problems when retrieving chapter pages and images.
Interrupted chapter transfers retain their resumable temporary files and respect pause and Wi-Fi-only settings.
fixed: Incomplete chapter folders no longer appear complete simply because the file count matches.
Failed CBZ or chapter-folder renames no longer mark a download complete or discard its temporary pages.
HTTP 403, 404 and 429 responses are not repeatedly retried by the chapter downloader.
